name: Inno Laser Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Inno Laser Technology Co., Ltd., based in Shenzhen, China, specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and global sales of advanced laser systems primarily designed for micromachining applications. The company offers a diverse range of laser solutions: Compact Medium and Low-Power Nanosecond Lasers: These are suitable for precision tasks such as 3D printing, static and dynamic marking, cutting of PCBs/FPCs, glass engraving, and laser trimming. Integrated High-Power Lasers: Engineered for demanding uses, these lasers facilitate PCB/FPC cutting, PI cover film cutting, processing of solar cells and wafers, integration into mobile phone camera/fingerprint modules, mobile phone antenna cutting, precision machining of brittle and transparent materials, and various PCB/FPC cutting and drilling operations. Industrial-Grade Femtosecond Lasers: Addressing highly precise needs, these lasers are employed in injector drilling, machining of aerospace brittle components, micro/nano-scale processing, semiconductor wafer fabrication, precision machining for interventional medical devices, battery electrode micromachining, and sophisticated surface microstructure modification. MOPA Nanosecond/Sub-Nanosecond Lasers: These are utilized for photovoltaic chip processing, glass drilling and texturing, removal of glass-based inks, and various PCB/FPC cutting and drilling tasks. Inno Laser's cutting-edge products find extensive application across critical sectors, including consumer electronics, new energy, 3D printing, chip manufacturing, and biomedical fields. Established in 2011, the company has expanded its reach significantly, distributing its solutions to approximately 20 countries and regions worldwide. Key international markets include the United States, Germany, the Netherlands, Japan, South Korea, India, and Singapore, in addition to its robust domestic presence in China.
